Family note for unit 1 goes home (English and Spanish). Printed pages only.

goal: Finish the inventory and read it as reflection; rank the work values cards privately on the plan page and explain, privately, how the top two values would steer a job choice.

goal: Introduce the cluster map: the 14 clusters, the ways jobs are grouped, and three options in two clusters found from one interest.

goal: Read a model plan for its parts and write near and far goals on the plan page, each on the goal steps card.

SEL g8-sm-set-goal comes later (SEL unit 18, school days 135 to 155), so the card is retrieval for a student who took SEL 6 to 8 and is taught from the card for one who did not. Private plan template on a device is optional; the plan page is the paper path.

goal: Write the first plan: two clusters linked from the inventory and the school subjects that lead toward one job.
note: The plan is scored later on its reasoning, never on the path chosen or the student's circumstances; no route is the default.

goal: Show why a plan built on old facts misleads, then sort the kinds of career information and where each is found.
note: An invented old figure beside the current handbook figure for the same job. Sources: the federal outlook handbook (public domain) and the federal occupational database (CC BY 4.0, credit line only).

goal: Teach the job study on the job card: one job, three kinds of information, each figure with its source and year, marked national.
note: Opens with a five-minute retrieval task: an hourly wage turned into a weekly and yearly figure (m7-unit-rate-fractions, grade 7). Figures from the dated data sheet, each with its source and year, marked national; the sheet carries "check these figures this school year". One shared screen shows a dated job profile; printed profile is the paper path. Profile at most 150 words.

goal: Complete a second job study on a new job card, checking each figure's source and year with a partner.
note: The second job is in the other cluster the plan names. Figures from the dated data sheet, each with its source and year, marked national; the sheet carries "check these figures this school year".

goal: Open with a five-minute retrieval task on lateral reading (who stands behind one source, checked in two others); then check four sources on one job with the lateral reading card (stop, investigate the source, look for better coverage, trace the claim to its original) and rank them for trust.
note: Opens with retrieval: library g6-lateral-reading is used in grade 7 by one hop (library 6 to 8 day 20 teaches g7-lateral-hard-cases, which assumes it), so it is retrieval by the counted rule. Lean g8-news-lateral (library 6 to 8 grade 8 unit 9, school days 98 to 143, later): the day teaches the shared lateral reading card in library 9 to 12's words (stop, investigate the source, look for better coverage, trace the claim to its original; library g9-lateral-method, the end form of library's lateral card), so a student meets one card in both courses. Four-source set: an invented old article, an invented recruiting ad, an invented worker's post and a dated handbook page, all printed. The day still teaches the card's four steps for a student who never took library.

goal: Sort job card figures into a table and read the one decision it supports; each pair takes a three-minute turn entering and sorting two rows at the shared device and names one privacy step.
note: Opens with retrieval: two data displays of the same jobs compared (m7-compare-populations, grade 7). One shared device with a free offline spreadsheet; nothing personal entered, the file kept on the school device; the class builds and sorts the same table on paper meanwhile. A student who cannot use a device meets the digital part as begun (finished in Pathways, g10-prac-5-digital-data); the teacher record says so.

goal: Name how I usually decide and recall one school choice that shows it, then teach the decision steps card and run it on a real course choice: which job the field task compares first.

A student who did not take SEL 6 to 8 is taught the card whole. The day claims only the career indicators. Decision steps card written by Curio Class.

goal: Explain first, from two invented cases, why a choice made with facts beats a guess; then use facts about self, job and training to make the choice, and write one plan line a job study changed.

goal: Field task: choose between two jobs with the decision steps card and the table, defend the choice with one figure, and draft the plan's changed line.
